text:
Why, at this point,
should I trouble myself
with writing in magazines, dead pages, or books?
Why should I care about a name
when I already have yours and mine?
Why indifference, conferences,
anthologies, myths?
Why readings, translations,
when everything has already been said?

I have changed
my methods and style.

And now, to work!

To write upon your body
with fingers dipped in wine.
